newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sterling hits 200 yen in Tokyo, highest since 1992.
newsitem.headline: Sterling hits 200 yen in Tokyo, highest since 1992.

text.p: The pound surged against the yen in afternoon Tokyo trade on Wednesday, hitting its highest level in almost 52 months, bankers said.
Sterling was quoted at around 200.02/14 yen at 0527 GMT, against 198.92 yen in early trade.
The pound's rally against the yen was fuelled by active buying of sterling for yen by securities houses, dealers said. The buying was related to fresh dual-currency bond issues, they said.
Individual investors, fed up with low interest rates in Japan, remain keen to invest in these high-yielding instruments, they said.

A dealer said there was talk that recent sterling/yen dual-currency bonds offered by securities houses had sold out quickly. The dollar's rally to 123 yen also helped push sterling up against the yen, dealers said. Tokyo treasury desk --81-3-3432-1396
